title: Opposition anger as Guinea’s junta leader is frontrunner to be elected president
summary: Mamady Doumbouya accused of betraying his promise to be the restorer of democracy after leading 2021 coup In September 2021, a tall, young colonel in the Guinean army announced that he and his comrades had forcibly seized power and toppled the longtime leader Alpha Condé. “The will of the strongest has always supplanted the law,” Mamady Doumbouya said in a speech, stressing that the soldiers were acting to restore the will of the people. title: Judge to hold hearing on whether Kilmar Abrego Garcia is being vindictively prosecuted
summary: A federal judge this week canceled the trial of Kilmar Abrego Garcia, and scheduled a hearing on whether the prosecution is being vindictive in pursuing a human smuggling case against him.

title: UN renews Sudan ceasefire appeal over ‘unimaginable suffering’ of civilians
summary: Secretary-General Antonio Guterres appeals for immediate truce as fighting intensifies in Darfur and Kordofan regions.
